title: The ceiling on stored unknown sign-in names is checked by a set-up excess, not by a forced race between writers
notes: The check fails on a build that forgets 2 names per sign-in and passes 3 of 3 on the build; the 10-flood observation under CI's shape is the evidence for concurrent writers (docs/testing.md, JS-172). An operator would notice only if the signin tables grew past the bound in docs/access.md. Promote when any deployment or queue run shows a row count over the bound plus the sign-ins in flight, or when the code that caps the count is next changed, which then needs a check under real contention before it merges (CLAUDE.md: concurrency claims need real processes or real contention).
